about.title: About
paragraphs: I learned sales in the family business, L'Ardoisière: ten years advising architects, designers, homeowners and distributors, and opening new accounts.
In 2020, in the middle of the pandemic, I also worked as a care attendant in a long-term care home (CHSLD). That experience strengthened what still guides the way I sell: listen before proposing.

I then trained in virtual and augmented reality and joined Proteus-VR as a developer. I built the product from the inside before presenting it, as VP of Technology, to school districts in four countries.
Since then, I went back to the field: restaurant service, then car sales at ALBI Occasion.
Today I am turning to AI, automation and cybersecurity. What ties this whole journey together does not change: understanding people's needs and offering them the right solution.

emerging.builtTitle: This site was built with AI
builtSteps: The brief: a precise specification with an absolute honesty rule: nothing made up.
The process: visual directions, research on award-winning Awwwards sites, a spec, a 12-step plan, then building with Claude Code.
The checks: automated tests before every feature, accessibility and performance audits, a final code review.
